The structure of Co5Ni crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Co10Ni2) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements: Co centers have 12 geometric neighbors (8 Co, 4 Ni), while Ni centers have 12 Co neighbors, with distances spanning roughly 2.44–2.52 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions across all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Co-centered 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge-sharing between Co- and Ni-centered polyhedra.
